en: Dependent on a state that has a non-mental object as its object and is not a root-condition … (Abbreviated.

Under root-condition there are nine; under object-condition three; under predominance-condition five … pe … under mutuality-condition six … pe … under prenascence and repetition-conditions one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition nine.
Dependent on a state that is not mental and is not a root-condition … [and so forth].

Dependent on a state that is not mental concomitant and not a root … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are nine … pe … under the prenascence and repetition conditions there are five … pe … under the non-disappearance condition there are nine.
Dependent on a state that is not associated with consciousness and not a root … pe … dependent on a state that is not conjoined with consciousness and not a root … (Abbreviated.
Under the root condition there are nine, under the object condition three, under the predominance condition five … pe … under the mutuality condition … [nine].
Six ... [etc. ... in relation to the pre-arisen and the habitual, one ...

[etc. ... in relation to the non-disappearance, nine. Dependent on a state that is not mind-originated and not a root ... [abbreviated]. In the root condition, nine; in the object condition, nine; in the predominance condition, five ... [etc. ... in the pre-arisen and habitual conditions, five ...

[etc. ... in the non-disappearance condition, nine. Dependent on a state that is not co-existent with mind and not a root ... [etc. ... dependent on a state that does not accompany the mind and is not a root ... [etc.]
Dependent on ... [as above] ... dependent on a state that is not conjoined with mind, not produced by mind, and is not a root; ...

dependent on a state that is not conjoined with mind, not produced by mind, is co-existent, and is not a root; ... dependent on a state that is not conjoined with mind, not produced by mind, and does not follow upon mind, and is not a root.
(Abbreviated. Nine in the case of root ... [as above] ... five in the cases of prenascence and repetition ... nine in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on an internal state that is not a cause … pe … dependent on an external state that is not a cause … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are nine; under the object condition, five; under the predominance condition, five … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, nine.

Dependent on a state that is neither-clung-to and not a cause … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are five; under the object condition, three; under the predominance condition, three … pe … under the prenascence and repetition conditions, one … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, five.
Dependent on a state that is not-acquired-by-clinging and not a cause … pe … dependent on a state that is not-not-acquired-by-clinging and not a cause … (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, five; in the object condition, two; in the predominance condition, one …pe… in the repetition condition, one …pe… in the non-disappearance condition, five.
